storyTagline: The Eagles go 17-0 and beat the Steelers in Super Bowl CLII for a third straight title, Ryland Maxwell takes the career rushing record, and Bones Crawford throws 64 touchdown passes on his way to a fourth MVP.

stories.headline: Perfect: Eagles Go 17-0, Then Beat the Steelers in Super Bowl CLII
stories.dek: Philadelphia won all 20 of its games, beat Pittsburgh 30-17 at home and gave Dorren Skura his 67th title and his third in a row.

stories.headline: Mad Max Passes McCoy and Takes the Career Rushing Record
stories.dek: Ryland Maxwell ran for 2,145 yards in Y93 and finished at 25,701, 1,194 clear of Lane McCoy. The record board now carries his name for career rushing touchdowns as well.

stories.headline: The Doctor Throws 64 Touchdown Passes and Wins a Fourth MVP
stories.dek: Bones Crawford played all 20 games, completed 281 of 317 passes and won his fifth ring, every one of them in Philadelphia.

stories.headline: Viennes Catches for 2,007 Yards and Is Offensive Player of the Year
stories.dek: Keenan Viennes caught 107 passes for 2,007 yards and 29 touchdowns in his second season. Calvin Wingo II finished 31 yards behind him.

stories.headline: Watts Is Defensive Player of the Year, and Lazard Is the Rookie of the Year
stories.dek: DQ Watts made 225 tackles and 5 interceptions for 13-4 Houston. Alshon Lazard threw 39 touchdown passes for 14-3 Cincinnati.

stories.headline: Three Tries, Three Losses: Ty Lock's Giants Still Cannot Beat Philadelphia
stories.dek: New York lost 30-22, 24-23 and 38-28 to the Eagles and has now lost all 13 meetings since Y88. Washington was swept again.

stories.headline: A Year On, Dwayne Skura and Kaulani Rahman Watch the Eagles Win Again
stories.dek: The two champions Philadelphia traded before Y92 had solid seasons in Indianapolis and Los Angeles. Both clubs went out after one playoff game.

stories.headline: Hainsey Closes In on Two Career Records, and Bello Is a Sack From Suh
stories.dek: Odell Hainsey is 2 interceptions behind Damar Hobbs and 196 tackles behind K'Lavon Settle. Deshone Bello needs 1 sack to tie Kalif Suh.

didYouKnow.text: Josh Brooks, 38, and Tevin Fox, 39, went through Y93 without throwing an interception, Brooks with 43 touchdown passes and Fox with 31.
Bones Crawford completed 281 of 317 passes in Y93 and threw 64 touchdowns.
Niles Canaday ran for 40 touchdowns for the Giants at 23, the most in the league, and caught 3 passes all season.
Skura's Eagles have not lost since week 5 of Y92: 35 straight wins, with two Super Bowls inside the streak.
Since Y88 the Eagles have played the Giants 13 times and won all 13, three of them in Y93.
Siran Spector has 373 career rushing touchdowns, 1 fewer than Rondale Ikarras.
Alshon Lazard ran for 10 touchdowns as a rookie quarterback for the Bengals and threw 39 more.

Ryland Maxwell has 10 rings with three clubs, the Jets, Falcons and Eagles, and Dorren Skura coached him to every one.

All 21 Defensive Player of the Year awards on league cards belong to defensive backs. The game credits a corner or safety's stop on a pass play as an interception, and the award rating counts each interception as much as 6 tackles. Jayon Queen leads with 2 awards.

Defensive linemen have 84 career interceptions in 7,618 games, one every 91 games; defensive backs pick one off every 9.3 games. The game scores a lineman's stop on a pass play as a sack: linemen have 352 sacks, defensive backs 1.

The league's three career tackle leaders, K'Lavon Settle (3,185), Terron Stidham (3,132) and Odell Hainsey (2,989), have no Defensive Player of the Year award between them: the award rating gives half a point a tackle and 3 points an interception, sack or forced fumble.
Retro Bowl caps each draft class by the coach's last record. After Skura's Eagles went 17-0 in Y93 (100%), prospects 5 to 50 of the Y94 class could rate at most 3 stars; a .500 season allows 3.5.
Winning shrinks the draft: in 70 of Skura's 75 seasons that fed a draft at the same club, his record capped the next class at 3 stars or less.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Sherman Brandson
vault.text: The General never flinched. Career Legacy 13,391, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Rondale Ikarras
vault.text: Flashy, loud, unstoppable, and he knew it. He was that guy. Career Legacy 11,725, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · God Johnson
vault.text: He changed his name to God. Then he earned it. Career Legacy 12,555, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Jayon Queen
vault.text: Two Defensive Player of the Year awards. Only one other player in this league has ever matched that. Career Legacy 8,628, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Tyrone Baugh
vault.text: Seven seasons, seven championships, and Tyrone Baugh has a ring for every one of them. Career Legacy 8,320, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Levante Hopkins
vault.text: The quiet one who did the dirty work. Career Legacy 11,257, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Mose Junior
vault.text: Some players chase rings. Mose Junior chased ball carriers. Career Legacy 7,640, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Dennis Baylon
vault.text: Seven trips to the Super Bowl. Seven rings. Not one loss. Career Legacy 10,260, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Charlie John
vault.text: Seven straight Super Bowls. Charlie John was there for every one of them. Career Legacy 9,930, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Ian Finney
vault.text: The first superstar. The Infinity Man. Career Legacy 11,229, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Bilal Tolbert
vault.text: No individual trophies. Four rings. And a sack record nobody has caught. Career Legacy 8,331, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Wayne Wilson
vault.text: Four hundred thirty-one games. Nobody in this league has played longer. Career Legacy 9,373, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Cairo Asanjh
vault.text: Some players chase records. Cairo Asanjh chased Ian Finney. Career Legacy 10,203, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Jahmyr Gibbs
vault.text: Mr. Incredible was here at the start, and he set the bar high. Career Legacy 7,978, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Zander Kolar
vault.text: Some defensive linemen are measured in sacks. Zander Kolar was measured in tackles. Career Legacy 8,590, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Ray Waller
vault.text: Never count out a man whose nickname is a promise. Career Legacy 8,795, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Tyler Pacheco
vault.text: Tyler Pacheco never needed the big play. He needed the ball, and he got it. Career Legacy 7,726, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Lukas Russell
vault.text: The Running Man started fast and never slowed down. Career Legacy 9,200, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Taron Hayes
vault.text: Eleven tackles a game, for 213 games, and two Defensive Player of the Year awards. Career Legacy 7,059, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Nick Bolton
vault.text: One of the originals, and he never stopped tackling. Career Legacy 8,596, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Michael Wilson
vault.text: Wayne's brother, and nobody's afterthought. Career Legacy 8,658, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Jackson Wardell Kline
vault.text: Tyrion Kline's son did not live in anyone's shadow. He built his own. Career Legacy 9,971, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Malakai Sawyer
vault.text: Some backs have a great season. Malakai Sawyer keeps having them. Career Legacy 7,879, Y88 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · K'Lavon Settle
vault.text: Fifteen seasons in San Francisco, and nobody on a card has made more tackles. Career Legacy 7,644, Y88 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Daren Teamer
vault.text: Eleven tackles a game is a Hall of Fame habit, and Daren Teamer has never broken it. Career Legacy 8,168, Y89 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Kalif Suh
vault.text: A Jets linebacker since Y76, and the middle of that defense has rarely moved without him. Career Legacy 9,109, Y92 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Jakeem Friend
vault.text: Linemen do not win trophies. Jakeem Friend won seven rings instead. Career Legacy 9,668, Y93 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Lane McCoy
vault.text: Every time Denver got close to the goal line, the whole league knew who was getting the ball. Career Legacy 6,835, Y93 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Damar Hobbs
vault.text: No defender in league history has taken the ball away through the air more often than Damar Hobbs. Career Legacy 8,300, Y93 class.

vault.title: Broncos Series: 5–0
vault.text: Skura met the Broncos in 5 Super Bowls and won all 5: LXXV (Y16) W 22–16, LXXXII (Y23) W 46–11, LXXXIV (Y25) W 38–16, CXLIII (Y84) W 32–28 and CXLVII (Y88) W 40–22.

vault.title: Texans Series: 3–1
vault.text: Skura met the Texans in 4 Super Bowls and went 3–1: XCVII (Y38) W 24–16, CXLV (Y86) W 48–13, CXLVI (Y87) W 30–21 and CXLIX (Y90) L 22–32.

vault.title: Bengals Series: 4–0
vault.text: Skura met the Bengals in 4 Super Bowls and won all 4: LXII (Y3) W 30–22, CXXVII (Y68) W 32–14, CXLIV (Y85) W 30–20 and CXLVIII (Y89) W 44–14.

vault.title: Buccaneers Series: 4–0
vault.text: Skura met the Buccaneers in 4 Super Bowls and won all 4: LXX (Y11) W 30–20, LXXXVIII (Y29) W 40–33, XCIX (Y40) W 38–22 and C (Y41) W 40–28.

vault.title: Bears Series: 2–2
vault.text: Skura met the Bears 4 times in Y88, Y89, Y91 and Y92 and went 2-2: Y88 week 15 W 40-33, Y89 week 1 W 38-14, Y91 week 13 L 30-36 and Y92 week 3 L 32-35.

vault.title: Jaguars Series: 1–1
vault.text: Skura met the Jaguars 2 times in Y90 and Y92 and went 1-1: Y90 week 9 W 32-22 and Y92 week 5 L 32-33.
